name: Adult fishes (bass, perch, crappie, rock bass)
description: The lake's top predators: adult largemouth bass, yellow perch, black crappie and rock bass. Functional group pooling the source's four adult fish taxa; the source's gut-content records show them eating invertebrates and young fishes, with incidental algal and plant material. Nothing in the web eats them.
